long_biography.plain_text:
A Geneva citizen resident in Zug, Löer works across a group of businesses established during his father Manfred’s property-development career. AAA provides architecture and planning services, SuissePromotion builds and sells housing, and SPI holds, manages and promotes property. Steven and his brother William entered the boards of these companies in 2023, several years after their father’s death.

The brothers also created SNC Les Promotions du Léman, a general partnership for property transactions and related design work, and took leadership of SuisseCare, the family-linked charitable foundation. Steven’s public role now centres on board and partnership governance across the inherited real-estate and architecture platform, alongside the family’s charitable stewardship.
